vehicles.name: 750S SPIDER
vehicles.summary: Lighter, faster, and louder. The purest expression of raw driver engagement with a 13-second folding hardtop.
vehicles.overviewHeadline: RELENTLESS PROGRESS. MORE POWER. MORE CONTROL.
vehicles.overviewText: The 750S takes the McLaren ethos to a new apex. True to its DNA, it's the next-level supercar, surpassing benchmarks for performance.
vehicles.lightnessText: 30% of components are new or revised compared to the 720S, resulting in an overall 30kg weight reduction.
vehicles.engagementHeadline: SURGICAL STEERING & PROACTIVE CHASSIS CONTROL III
vehicles.engagementText: Features a 6mm wider front track, twin-valve hydraulic dampers, and a faster steering rack ratio.
vehicles.powerText: At the heart of the 750S is a 4-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine mid-mounted for perfect weight distribution.

vehicles.name: 720S SPIDER
vehicles.summary: An open-top benchmark supercar engineered for relentless power, active downforce, and uncompromised road presence.
vehicles.overviewText: The McLaren 720S Spider is the culmination of our pursuit to push the boundaries of open-top supercar performance.
vehicles.lightnessText: Derived from Formula 1 composite technology, it provides immense structural rigidity.
vehicles.engagementText: Electro-hydraulic steering provides pure, unassisted dynamic feel.
vehicles.powerText: Generating 710 HP and 770 Nm of torque, propels from 0 to 200 km/h in 7.9 seconds.

vehicles.name: ARTURA
vehicles.summary: Next-generation electrified hybrid performance blending instant electric torque with a howling twin-turbo V6.
vehicles.overviewText: Artura combines ultralight engineering with instant electric torque response and relentless twin-turbocharged V6 power.
vehicles.lightnessText: Bespoke carbon fibre monocoque optimized specifically for hybrid powertrain integration.
vehicles.engagementText: First McLaren to feature an Ethernet electrical architecture and electronically controlled differential.
vehicles.powerText: Blends instant 95PS electric torque with 585PS twin-turbo V6 combustion power.

vehicles.name: W1 HYPERCAR
vehicles.summary: Our Formula One-inspired ground-effect flagship hypercar redefining aerodynamics and hybrid hypercar performance.
vehicles.overviewText: Inspired by Formula 1 ground-effect aerodynamics, the McLaren W1 stands as the ultimate expression of extreme hypercar performance.
vehicles.lightnessText: Integrated structural seating reduces wheelbase requirements for optimum aerodynamics.
vehicles.engagementHeadline: ACTIVE LONG TAIL AERO & RACE ACTIVE CHASSIS CONTROL
vehicles.engagementText: Rear wing extends 300mm backwards in Race Mode, generating up to 1,000kg of downforce.
vehicles.powerText: High-rpm all-new V8 combined with lightweight E-module produces unprecedented power-to-weight ratio.

pillars.title: Carbon Monocage II
pillars.text: Formula 1 derived carbon monocoque cell providing maximum torsional rigidity and lightweight safety.

pillars.title: Proactive Chassis Control
pillars.text: Hydraulically interlinked suspension adapting dampers in milliseconds for ultimate cornering grip.

pillars.title: Active Aerodynamics
pillars.text: Continuously adjusting active rear wing and front air splitters optimizing downforce and drag.
